2108. Topological Sort

50

Medium

Problem Statement
Given a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG), print the topological ordering of all vertices.
Input Format
- First line contains n and m.
- Next m lines contain directed edges u v.
Output Format
Print the topological order as space-separated integers.
